title: Calculation Sheet: Closing Entry of a Manufacturer Copay Card Benefit Period (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The closing entry of a Manufacturer Copay Card benefit period under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs lapses every dollar left for the period, keeping no carry-forward. The amount booked is stated to the cent, rounded half up.

**Dollars left.** The dollars left are the credits of the period-opening entries and benefit reversals less the benefit entries and earlier closing entries, all as the card's activity shows them.

## Worked figures (hypothetical card activity)

| Opening entries | Benefit reversals | Benefit entries | Earlier closing entries | Dollars left | Closing entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $9600.00 | $50.00 | $7200.00 | $0.00 | $2450.00 | $2450.00 |
| $9600.00 plus $9600.00 | $0.00 | $12000.00 | $5000.00 | $2200.00 | $2200.00 |
| $9600.00 | $0.00 | $9600.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
